description: Pin a computer chat's row id to a known SHA-256 digest in apps/shared/app-navigation.coax and verify in chat-library-checks.coax.

steps.send: In `apps/shared/app-navigation.coax` and `apps/openagents-ios/chat-library-checks.coax`: ensure a computer chat's row id is deterministically derived using SHA-256 and add a pinned known-answer `#test` in `apps/openagents-ios/chat-library-checks.coax` verifying the exact hex digest. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-ios/chat-library-checks.coax`.

graders.run: grep -qiE 'sha-?256' apps/shared/app-navigation.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/shared/app-navigation.coax --only "row id"
